# Data Source: okta_request_sequences

Lists all access request sequences for a resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okta_request_sequences" "example" {
  resource_id = "<okta_resource_id>"
}

# Look up a sequence by name
locals {
  manager_approval_sequence_id = one([
    for seq in data.okta_request_sequences.example.request_sequences : seq.id
    if seq.name == "Requester's Manager Approval"
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) The id of the resource in Okta ID format or ORN format.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the resource whose request sequences are listed. Same as `resource_id`.
- `request_sequences` (List of Object) The list of request sequences for the resource. Each element has the attributes `id`, `name`, `description`, `link` and `compatible_resource_types`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--request_sequences))

<a id="nestedatt--request_sequences"></a>
### Nested Schema for `request_sequences`

Read-Only:

- `compatible_resource_types` (List of String)
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `link` (String)
- `name` (String)
